solverForce.reset: Each solver pass resets contact fx/fy/fz before processing its contact points.
solverForce.perPointFormula: force += (normal * normalImpulse + tangent * tangentImpulse + binormal * binormalImpulse) * INV_DT
solverForce.units: impulse-per-fixed-step converted to force by INV_DT

voxelContactProjection.compactGrouping: same packed axis and same coordinate along that axis
voxelContactProjection.cutoffRule: retain a group when any absolute summed force component exceeds the cutoff
voxelContactProjection.retainedForce: component-wise group sum divided by group contact count, copied to each retained contact

contactForceProperty.reason: ContactBinding implementation is absent; the rule that aggregates active contact records into GameEntity.contactForce is still unavailable.
